input.timestamp_timezone: unspecified source-naive; no UTC or exchange-time assertion
input.rights: Raw and resampled positions remain private; publish acquisition route, fingerprints and aggregates only.

resampling.group: source timestamp converted to datetime64[D] without timezone conversion
resampling.selected_record: last strictly ordered original observation within each nonempty source-naive day
resampling.issue_clock: end of that completed source-naive day: day + 1 day - 1 microsecond
resampling.why_issue_at_day_end: The identity of the day's last record is not known at its original timestamp. All records in the completed day are known under this retrospective clock.
resampling.missing_day: no row and no report; no fill, interpolation, synthetic zero or weekend adjustment
resampling.partial_first_or_last_day: retain by the same last-observed-record rule; no outcome-based completeness exclusion
resampling.private_mapping: selected original row indices, original timestamps, daily positions and issue times under task scratch only
resampling.public_metadata: aggregate counts/date range/gap histogram, mapping and daily-series hashes; no daily values or full selected-index vector
resampling.fingerprints: SHA256 on canonical contiguous little-endian bytes: selected indices<i8, selected original timestamps in microseconds<i8, day-end issue timestamps in microseconds<i8, and positions<f8. Combined hash is SHA256(ASCII v8-daily-v1 followed by byte0x00, then these four byte vectors in that order).
resampling.worker_consistency: Each sequential cell worker parses the same pinned snapshot and repeats the deterministic aggregation; all public resampling fingerprints must match. Parent imports only stdlib.

clock_and_target.horizon_unit: next recorded nonempty source-naive day-end observations
clock_and_target.intraday_excursions: not part of the daily target; aggregation changes the sampled target

sample.adaptation: Original Treasury observation-index geometry, not its 2021 absolute calendar cutoff and not a proportional split.
sample.purge: 24 issue indices between validation last380 and evaluation first405; last H24 validation response ends404
sample.common_issue_grid: same validation/evaluation indices across methods and all four W/H cells
sample.insufficient_sample: If validation/evaluation is unavailable, or earliest training origin for the cell is below common feature-valid index26, report the whole cell NA_SAMPLE_SIZE with exact reason; do not shorten W, move cutoffs, fill days or retune.
sample.why_calendar_not_copied: Treasury evaluation begins after2021-01-01; the accepted FX source is earlier. Copying that absolute date cannot evaluate this source. Report the scope mismatch explicitly.

features.constant_features: original training-only constant-column standardization; no feature selection based on outcomes

forecasting.refit_grid: starts separately at validation329 and evaluation405, as original Treasury procedure
forecasting.F: corrected rank ceil(19*(W+1)/20) of mature own-anchor headroom; add current absolute-position floor; freeze selected headroom within each13-issue block
forecasting.QR33: original33 features, training-only original transform and response scale, original ridge-quantile solver
forecasting.QR4: original four predictors, original C-order training transform and response scale, original ridge-quantile solver
forecasting.sealed_reuse: Use WP3-sealed v8_mechanism_mc.forecast_report F/QR33/QR4 paths without modification. Do not call helpers that also compute S/K or other unlisted models.

selection.QR33: all three declared validation candidates must complete; lowest mean pinball wins; exact tie chooses larger penalty
selection.QR4: choose among completed declared candidates; lowest mean pinball wins; exact tie chooses first increasing penalty
selection.failed_candidate: retain reason and available fit diagnostics, never substitute zero loss
selection.selected_evaluation_failure: whole method NA/FAILED; no other penalty or truncated evaluation replaces it

outputs.public: four cell receipts,12 method summaries,8 regression-versus-F contrasts, all32 declared validation candidate records, selected penalties, failure/NA reasons, maturity and actual resources
outputs.scores: original tau19/20 pinball mean and strict peak>capacity breach count/rate on identical complete issue grid; full precision stored
outputs.private: raw/daily source values, per-issue forecasts/targets/scores and exact resampling mapping under .scratch only

predeclared_interpretation.per_regression_denominator: four predeclared W/H cells; no weighting by favorable sample size
predeclared_interpretation.complete: all four selected evaluations and their matched F complete
predeclared_interpretation.tie: exact equal mean losses; not a win
predeclared_interpretation.TREASURY_LIKE: all four comparisons complete and historical wins in at least3/4
predeclared_interpretation.CONDITIONAL_GAINS_PERSIST: all four comparisons complete and regression wins in at least3/4
predeclared_interpretation.MIXED: all four complete and neither procedure-specific majority condition holds
predeclared_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: For that regression separately, any of its own four regression-versus-F comparisons missing; retain available counts without a complete-case dominance claim. Failure of the other regression does not contaminate this classification.
predeclared_interpretation.literal_hourly_only_claim: Any complete daily conditional score gain is a descriptive counterexample to a literal hourly-required claim; not population superiority evidence.
predeclared_interpretation.combined: report QR33 and QR4 separately; differing patterns are method-dependent rather than one global frequency explanation
predeclared_interpretation.central_claim_non_support: Conditional gains persisting on daily FX weaken a simple hourly-only explanation. Historical dominance is consistent with effects of aggregation/history scale within this source, not proof of a frequency cause.
predeclared_interpretation.causal_boundary: Same dealer fixes source identity only. Observation frequency, physical horizon, physical history length, calendar features and sampled target change jointly. Neither outcome identifies a pure frequency or pure source effect; this does not supply independent-dealer validation.

design.randomness: none: deterministic resampling, menus and chronological indices; no random split or seed

resources.deadline: interrupt in-flight owned worker at min(worker600s,global remaining); preserve partial and unattempted cells
resources.order: W ascending, H listed6 then24; inside each cell F thenQR33 thenQR4

source_spec.local_symlink_policy: an explicitly supplied local symlink may resolve to a regular opened file; validate that same bounded snapshot; no output symlinks
source_spec.public_download_metadata: fixed endpoint, status, HTTPS host and query-presence only; no actual signed storage path/query, response body or exception text
source_spec.redirect_handling: manual single302; both openers disable automatic redirects; close redirect/error bodies without reading
source_spec.proxy_policy: direct ProxyHandler({}); no implicit proxy credentials
source_spec.redirect_request: GET without forwarded POST body/headers; exact HTTPS storage.googleapis.com:443; reject userinfo/fragment; transient signed query memory only
source_spec.error_body_policy: close without reading/logging; fixed sanitized error codes
source_spec.stream_deadline_check: remaining global wall budget and bounded socket timeouts; resource checkpoint during chunks
